\section{All}
```{r fig22a, echo = FALSE, fig.topcaption=TRUE, results = 'asis', fig.height = 4,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

stock_base <- "all"
from_dir <- paste0("tmp/portfolio_results/", stock_base, "/statistics/cf_dr/")

# 1. Load all sensitivity files (h1, h2, h4, h8, h20, h40)
fill_horizons <- c(1, 2, 4, 8, 20, 40)
df_list <- lapply(fill_horizons, function(h) {
  file_path <- paste0(from_dir, "scale_h", h, ".RDS")
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    dt <- readRDS(file_path)
    return(dt)
  }
  return(NULL)
})

df_plot_all <- rbindlist(df_list, fill = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(var == "combined")

# ============================================================================
# DATA PREPARATION & HORIZON ALIGNMENT
# ============================================================================
df_plot_all <- df_plot_all %>%
  # Since all horizons (past, future, and anchor) are expressed in calendar months,
  # dividing by 12 correctly standardizes the entire x-axis timeline to years.
  mutate(hor_years = hor / 12) %>%
  
  # Create clean labels for your facet grid
  mutate(fill_label = paste0("Fill: ", fill_h, " Quarters")) %>%
  
  # Invert past returns to match standard cumulative horizon reporting
  mutate(coef = case_when(
    hor < 0  ~ -coef,
    TRUE   ~ coef
  )) %>%
  
  # Map factor model strings to pristine, publication-quality presentation text
  mutate(factor_model = case_when(
    factor_model == "cf"        ~ "Cash Flow Implied Return",
    factor_model == "raw_ret"   ~ "Raw Market Return (Daily CRSP)",
    factor_model == "sum_news"  ~ "cf+dr",
    TRUE                        ~ factor_model
  )) %>%
  setDT()

# ============================================================================
# PLOTTING FUNCTION WITH MULTI-LINE COMPARISONS & SHADED RIBBONS
# ============================================================================
plot_reversals_faceted <- function(data, title_text) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = hor_years, y = coef, color = factor_model, fill = factor_model, group = factor_model)) +
    # Reference baselines
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "red", alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # 95% Confidence Interval Overlap Band (1.96 * SE)
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = coef - 1.96 * se, ymax = coef + 1.96 * se), 
                color = NA, alpha = 0.12) +
    
    # Main Estimate Paths
    geom_line(lwd = 1.1) +
    
    # Facetting grid across sensitivity fill parameter limits
    facet_wrap(~fill_label, scales = "free_y") +
    
    # Axis formatting
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-5, 10, by = 1)) + # Step ticks by 1 year for enhanced precision
    
    # Color palette selection for premium clarity
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Cash Flow Implied Return" = "#1f77b4", 
                                  "Raw Market Return (Daily CRSP)" = "#ff7f0e")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Cash Flow Implied Return" = "#1f77b4", 
                                 "Raw Market Return (Daily CRSP)" = "#ff7f0e")) +
    
    labs(title = title_text,
         subtitle = "95% Newey-West Confidence Intervals (Overlapping Multi-Horizon Paths)",
         x = "Years from Portfolio Formation (T=0)",
         y = "Cumulative Horizon Log Return",
         color = "Model Specification",
         fill = "Model Specification") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "horizontal",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 10))
}

# ============================================================================
# GENERATE COMPARISON FIGURES
# ============================================================================

# 1. Symmetric Component: Combined Signal (CF vs Raw Return Comparison across All Fills)
p1 <- plot_reversals_faceted(
  df_plot_all[var_type == "sym" & var == "combined"], 
  "Symmetric Component: CF vs Raw Return"
)
print(p1)
cat("\\newline")
# 2. Total Component: Combined Signal (Optional add-on verification)
p2 <- plot_reversals_faceted(
  df_plot_all[var_type == "asy" & var == "combined"], 
  "Asymmetric Component: CF vs Raw Return"
)
print(p2)
```
